description: A structured elementary literacy intervention developed by Gillam and colleagues for improving narrative comprehension, production, and literate language in children with language and literacy difficulties.
title: SKILL (Supporting Knowledge in Language and Literacy)

description: A logic-model planning framework presented in the report Understanding, Valuing, and Utilizing Skills-First Practices as an Organization Supporting to guide stakeholders in building an aligned skills-first system.
title: Skills-first network logic model

description: A scenario-based offline assessment developed by Laura Dörrenbächer-Ulrich and colleagues that measures college students’ ability to distinguish useful from less useful cognitive, metacognitive, and motivational learning strategies in specific situations.
title: SKT-SRL: a scenario-based conditional strategy knowledge test

description: Skusie is a bilingual humanoid social-robot system developed by Yanghee Kim and colleagues to mediate collaborative interaction and peer play among culturally and linguistically diverse kindergarten children.
title: Skusie

description: A K–2 literacy curriculum launched and implemented by Chicago Public Schools in 2021.
title: Skyline ELA
